scope: Synthetic-only assessment reader checks. No native execution and no new native output consumption.

cases.name: complete-source-raw-route-chain
cases.expect: 14 source bindings, 15 untouched raw branches, four exact old route reproductions, and two descriptive control deltas

cases.name: unit-phase-contract-pass
cases.expect: Eight suite markers, exact timing and cleanup, and control17-14/raw15/old14/trial16-14 events in maintained registry order

cases.name: routes-phase-contract-pass
cases.expect: Two suite markers, exact timing and cleanup, and six pose-then-route pairs in protocol order

cases.name: source-case-order-rejected
cases.expect: Reordered control17 source bindings fail

cases.name: control17-density-policy-admission-rejected
cases.expect: Wrong density, policy, or admission identity fails

cases.name: source-graph-and-signed-long-rejected
cases.expect: Changed graph identity or an out-of-range signed-long seed fails

cases.name: source17-digest-and-canonical-rejected
cases.expect: Changed derived17 digest or canonical source fails

cases.name: untouched-raw-candidate-change-rejected
cases.expect: A changed nonselected raw candidate fails

cases.name: published-old-route-metric-change-rejected
cases.expect: Any changed non-timing field in the four published old route rows fails

cases.name: control17-pose-orientation-and-admission-rejected
cases.expect: TOP90 passive membership or wrong @3 admission identity fails

cases.name: route-case-order-rejected
cases.expect: Reordered route cases fail

cases.name: phase-pre-correction-report-order-rejected
cases.expect: The pre-correction request order old14/trial16-14/control17-14/raw15 fails against the maintained suite registry order

cases.name: phase-missing-suite-marker-rejected
cases.expect: Missing required suite PASS marker fails

cases.name: phase-failure-and-timeout-rejected
cases.expect: Failure status, nonzero exit, and timeout output fail

cases.name: phase-cleanup-missing-or-early-rejected
cases.expect: Missing cleanup or cleanup before terminal fails

cases.name: phase-timing-schema-and-scope-rejected
cases.expect: Extra timing key or wrong scope fails

cases.name: phase-duplicate-suite-marker-rejected
cases.expect: Duplicate expected suite PASS prefix in the log and receipt fails

cases.name: phase-suite-marker-order-rejected
cases.expect: Reordered expected suite PASS prefixes fail

cases.name: phase-log-receipt-suffix-mismatch-rejected
cases.expect: Different complete suite PASS lines between log and child receipt fail

cases.name: phase-unrelated-suffix-rejected
cases.expect: A suite PASS line with free-text instead of a recognized assertion/detail suffix fails
